name: Look To The Stars
label: Quest
description: Following the blueprints provided by the tinker Cog, Viktori Prism'Antras seeks a reflective surface to assemble his observatory telescope in Darkshire.…
intro: Following the blueprints provided by the tinker Cog, Viktori Prism'Antras seeks a reflective surface to assemble his observatory telescope in Darkshire. He directs travelers to southern Duskwood to locate Mary, a local woman remembered for carrying a looking glass.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light. I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass. Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project? I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
